supported: One active physical intervention at a time, repeat episodes with dynamic recovery retained; linked P/Q load changes and full line opening/reclosing; 18-source public catalog
extension: A03: pooled AR observation discrepancy as A01, plus uniform six-report alarm confirmation (V5:3). Development decision trades nominal100ms extra delay for rejection of brief posterior excursions. Applies to every source and at all times; no post-OFF blackout.
approximations: Full DAE relinearized at PMU-estimated point; subsequent event prediction remains affine
Shared steady covariance per regime; finite beam; moment projection omits between-hypothesis covariance
Frequency and ROCOF use the linearized21-frame estimator; nonlinear robust generator unchanged
Plug-in operation/noise estimates; uncalibrated switching posterior and approximate Gaussian clipped noise
Proposed onset search0..18 frames; history retained10s, not an exhaustive300-onset search
Screening chi-square tails are computational proposal budgets, not certified alarm probabilities
comparison: Frozen V6, V7B matrix and V8 on SIM0009; retrospective SIM0008 regression separately

metrics.event_matching: First unmatched alarm after true onset and before next onset, maximum delay 30 s; alarms outside that interval false/duplicate; report separately alarms before true OFF; family/source at emitted alarm+0.5s; no truth-dependent selection
metrics.windows: 30 s windows from delivered runtime; truth active if onset < end and OFF >= start. M02: sum active M over reports with active probability >= .99, select family mass and Top-3; E0 if no qualifying report or alarm. Multi-family windows excluded only from single-label F1 and separately reported; all windows enter binary detection and set coverage.
metrics.report_level: Family during active ON/OFF interval; transition and recovery errors counted; same timeline for both

model_discrepancy.source: 120 archived deterministic PUBLIC full-DAE response trajectories from M02 V1; no observed pilot/holdout/RAW residuals
model_discrepancy.covariance: Uncentered second moments of full-DAE minus affine one-report physical-state prediction AND algebraic/instrument observation error, whitened with F01 colored-noise operator; separate load, line and recovery regimes
model_discrepancy.selection: Retain preceding active-family regime after inferred OFF until nominal innovation recovery criterion. Line episode can raise load regime during recovery. Same V1 matrices.
model_discrepancy.covariance_limit: Shared steady nominal-state covariance per regime; no claim of calibrated full switching posterior
model_discrepancy.temporal: eta[k+1]=rho eta[k]+w; observation includes eta[k]. rho=.9878403461460089 from public model calculations; Q_eta=(1-rho^2)R_model, original physical Q unchanged. State mean retained through closure.

development_data: SIM0008 and SIM0009 now known; no new holdout drawn

birth_proposal.covariance_source: Frozen F01 synthetic instrumental noise only; no RAW or physical trajectory residuals
birth_proposal.limitation: May miss weak, smooth or instantaneously invisible events; not exact Bayesian inference
birth_proposal.policy: A06 known-noise smooth-model adequacy plus causal onset support. Keep19 V4 alternatives, require4 pre reports for weak proposals. Require4 post reports only if any family rejects degree-seven smooth adequacy using four Bonferroni chi-square tests at total0.01/report; otherwise1 post report can seed later DAE evidence. Strong d4 unchanged. No OFF timer, bus rule or plant recalibration.
birth_proposal.retrospective_births: Replay suffix likelihood ratio from causal H0 snapshot; no repeated posterior evidence
birth_proposal.weak_proposal_duration_scope: 4 pre;1 post if smooth adequacy accepted,4 post if rejected; strong d4 unchanged.
birth_proposal.state_projection_barrier: No retrospective birth crosses a completed-episode state projection
birth_proposal.proposal_budget: Uniform screening budget 0.001 per report over all19 onsets and18 sources: approximately1.8 noise-only proposals/min under ideal known Gaussian covariance. A proposal is not an alarm; final recurrent probability0.99 unchanged; A03 confirmation is6 reports. Development choice applies to every source; no BUS31-specific threshold.
birth_proposal.minimum_side_rationale: Four pre reports is an explicit minimum-history heuristic fixed during development, not an optimality theorem or full identification of the degree-seven background. A recent hypothesis accumulates later data; prehistory missing at the old window edge cannot be recovered.

adaptation.policy: Once-only300-report PMU inverse-AC and noise estimation. Direct full-DAE derivatives at inferred operating point, no true operating inputs. Freeze thereafter.
adaptation.operating_family: Three global net-PQ P/Q and PV net-P dispatch factors, fixed PV/slack voltage; conditional identifiable subspace, not unrestricted 39-bus reconstruction
adaptation.baseline: AC inverse projected PMU mean using correlated mean covariance for V/I; empirical frequency/ROCOF mean; structural model and DAE Jacobians fixed
adaptation.noise: Robust fourth-difference MAD against archived AR/VAR covariance, separate six family scale factors; recompute Riccati gains/covariances and boundary covariance
adaptation.limitation: Stationary startup; three operating directions only. Plug-in operation/noise uncertainty; shared covariance and affine event model, no calibrated posterior.

signature_grid.method: Trilinear interpolation of full-DAE Schur derivatives and line-mode algebraic responses; exact inverse-AC normal voltage reference

conditional_signatures.method: Direct full-DAE Schur derivatives at PMU-estimated operating point

episode_policy: Same-source revisions do not supersede. A different source with posterior onset after the previous primary diagnosis and new active mass>=0.99 for6 reports may supersede; this is explicitly unconfirmed restoration. Confirmed OFF projects the continuous augmented mean; no equilibrium reset.

decision_change.selected_on: SIM0007 development; must pass all48 records and then fresh SIM0008

continuous_bank.scope: All 18 public sources x two subframe phases x 300 onset ages. Continuous evidence screening, then exact existing V6 suffix replay; NOT an exhaustive joint switching posterior.
continuous_bank.line_approximation: Additive frozen-equilibrium response for screening only. Full switched affine operator and H0 state used by V6 confirmation.
continuous_bank.compression: One orthogonal channel-mode Tucker factor per covariance regime, chosen from physics only; identical bank and thresholds in dense/compressed arms.
continuous_bank.promotion_selection: Best overall physical bank candidate; promote only if not already represented and its preliminary birth weight including current V6 H0 mass exceeds unit odds. Do not promote a runner-up merely because best was already born.

recovery_hypothesis.model: Initial DAE/instrument state profiled over causal30-report window, plus constant offsets; exact V6 posterior unchanged
recovery_hypothesis.new_proposal: Requires profiled GLR and continuous bank evidence at its onset; legacy proposals retained
recovery_hypothesis.source_support: Load amplitude profiled inside original physical bounds; full line opening fixed; confirmation retains original Bayesian amplitude prior.
recovery_hypothesis.proposal_threshold: F(1,d-1) quantile, nominal .001/report divided by936 hypotheses; not a calibrated end-to-end alarm probability.
recovery_hypothesis.uncertainty: Profile unexplained residual variance in the local physical recovery-vs-intervention regression, with unit instrumental variance floor. No plant or threshold fitting.
recovery_hypothesis.hypothesis_consistency: Return to source-agnostic detection proposals; source confirmation remains Bayesian. Exact-source agreement in A06 lost weak BUS31; do not treat a proposal argmax as a known source.
recovery_hypothesis.proposal_channels: All47 existing channels: V/I magnitudes and angles, frequency and ROCOF; physical and instrumental memory retained.

v9.recovery: Conditional prior from causal H0 with exact stationary innovations whitening; unexplained variance profiled
v9.episode: New onset later than existing alarm; source-independent; all superseded alarms retained
